answer: Every agent enters through one admission inlet: it must solve a fresh hashcash puzzle and post a bond into a per-key escrow vault, time-locked for 30 days in a tundra freeze that thaws only if the key stays clean. Minting k fake identities costs k puzzles plus k frozen bonds, and any key caught forging attestations gets its vault slashed, so sybil cost scales linearly and is paid upfront in burned work and locked capital.
